law: Hunter A2 may propose pursuit movement but may not certify its own contact. Control effects require resolved physical contact.

explicitMoverAudit.hunter.pounce_weak: FIXED — proposes movement, defers contact to the post-movement resolver
explicitMoverAudit.hunter.snare (A1 recoil): SAFE — moves via moveHunterBody (wall authority), adjudicates no contact
explicitMoverAudit.robot.weapon_dash: SAFE — explicit mover, but contact authority is the real equip resolution (onEquipOffensive) which runs on the post-movement position; the dash never emits RobotA1Contact itself
explicitMoverAudit.sniper A2 position lock: NOT CONTACT-SENSITIVE — lock only, no body translation
explicitMoverAudit.slime promoted/child bodies: SAFE — driven through the full canonical engine pipeline (child.update)

S02-resolver-runs-after-movement.detail: resolver must run in hrPostTick, i.e. after Fighter.update

S04-resolver-uses-both-real-ordered-path.detail: piecewise relative sweep over both real ordered paths

S05-body-field-subsegments-recorded.detail: ordered body path keeps explicit / field / canonical stages distinct

S06-owner-rating-not-reused-as-speed-cap.detail: the 3500 rating is a field power anchor, not a velocity ceiling

S12-hunter-a2-does-not-adjudicate-inline.detail: the executor must not run its own contact sweep

S22-commit-only-reached-from-resolver.detail: exactly one definition + one call from the deferred onContact

S31-magnet-body-consumes-the-one-shared-.detail: body must use the shared S(d), not the superseded linear target

S40-robot-a1-dash-does-not-self-certify-.detail: Robot A1 moves explicitly but its contact authority is the real equip resolution
